topic: 学术综合任务与转段检查
grammarFocus: 根据个人错题复查时态、从句、冠词、数量和主谓一致。
title: Week 36 Listening: Academic Task and Transition Check (Simulated)
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。听录音前先读题。录音会播放两遍。注意说话人之间的自然轮换、纠正和干扰信息。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。判断题只有 True / False / Not Given 三个选项。所有解析为中文，证据为英文原文引用。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Dr. Chen. Thanks for meeting me. I'm Mia, the exchange student from the business faculty. I'm here for the week 36 academic check.
Dr. Chen: Of course, Mia. Come in. So, you're doing the joint project with the engineering students, right? The one on campus recycling?
Mia: Yes, that's right. But I'm a bit worried. My part is the survey report, and I have to submit it next Friday.
Dr. Chen: Next Friday, the 15th. Okay. How's it going?
Mia: Well, the data collection is finished. We interviewed 120 students. But when I started writing, I found some problems with my grammar. My tutor said my tense use is inconsistent.
Dr. Chen: That's common in reports. You need to use the past tense for what you did, and the present tense for general facts. For example, 'We interviewed 120 students' but 'The campus produces a lot of waste.'
Mia: Right. Also, I'm not sure about articles. Should I write 'the survey' or 'a survey' in the introduction?
Dr. Chen: In your introduction, first mention: 'a survey'. After that, 'the survey'. And check subject-verb agreement—like 'The number of participants was 120', not 'were'.
Mia: Okay. And relative clauses? I have sentences like 'The students who they answered the questionnaire...'
Dr. Chen: That's a double subject. Say 'The students who answered the questionnaire...'. No 'they'.
Mia: Got it. Another thing: quantity expressions. I wrote 'a large amount of students', but my friend said it's wrong.
Dr. Chen: Yes, use 'a large number of students' because students are countable. 'Amount' is for uncountable nouns, like 'a large amount of waste'.
Mia: Thank you. I also need to prepare for the transition check. What exactly is that?
Dr. Chen: It's a short interview where you explain your project and reflect on your learning. It's not a test of knowledge, but of communication. You'll present for five minutes, then answer questions.
Mia: Five minutes? I thought it was ten.
Dr. Chen: No, five minutes for the presentation, then five minutes for questions. So ten minutes in total.
Mia: Okay. And who will be there?
Dr. Chen: Two teachers, including me, and one student representative. The representative is from the second year.
Mia: Will I get a grade?
Dr. Chen: It's pass or fail, not a grade. But you'll receive written feedback.
Mia: That's a relief. One last thing: my friend said I should bring a printed copy of my report. Is that necessary?
Dr. Chen: Not necessary, but helpful. You can bring notes, but don't read from them.
Mia: Understood. Thank you, Dr. Chen.
Dr. Chen: You're welcome. See you next week.

grammar.title: 时态、从句、冠词、数量与主谓一致复习
grammar.explanation: 在学术写作中，描述过去的研究动作常用一般过去时（如 We interviewed 120 students），而陈述普遍事实常用一般现在时（如 The campus produces a lot of waste）。定语从句中，关系代词 who 已经作主语，后面不能再加 they。冠词方面，第一次提到某物用 a/an，再次提到用 the。数量表达要区分可数名词和不可数名词：可数名词用 a large number of，不可数名词用 a large amount of。主谓一致要注意主语的中心词，如 The number of participants 是单数，谓语用 was。
grammar.example: We interviewed 120 students. The campus produces a lot of waste.

Last week, we have collected data from 120 students.
answers: Last week, we collected data from 120 students.

answers: The students who answered the questionnaire were satisfied.

questions.evidence: The students who answered the questionnaire...

questions.evidence: In your introduction, first mention: 'a survey'. After that, 'the survey'.
